listing.title: Investigate: verified answers about your codebase
listing.summary: Turns a question about your system into a written answer where every claim that matters is measured with a command, never guessed. Read-only: no branch, no code change.

compatibility: Any agent that can run shell commands and read files. Parallel subagents make it faster but are not required.

replace.from:
becomes the spec for the task funnel; you do not edit files here. An
investigation that quietly turns into a change skips triage, tests and review,
which is every gate the funnel has.
replace.to:
becomes the spec for a separate change; you do not edit files here. An
investigation that quietly turns into a change skips triage, tests and review,
which is every gate a change is supposed to pass.

replace.from:
and the concurrency ceiling is `kit config get .maxParallelAgents` (with no `kit` on
PATH, `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/kit`).
replace.to: and three at once is the ceiling. Without subagents, take the angles in turn.

replace.from: - If the fix is then asked for, hand the finding to the task funnel as its spec.
replace.to: - If the fix is then asked for, the finding is its spec.
